credit_invoice.description: Only relevant for B2B Orders. If the flag is set to true for an order with B2B_invoice as payment method, the customer will receive the refund as a credit invoice.

description.description: Description of the refund shown to the customer. Max length is 255 characters.
description.example: The item was returned and the order refunded.

order_lines.description: Order lines for the refund shown to the customer. Optional but increases the customer experience. Maximum 1000 order lines.

reference.description: Internal reference to the refund that is also included in the settlement files. Max length is 255 characters.

refund_id.description: The refund id. Generated when the refund is created.

refunded_at.description: The time of the refund. ISO 8601.
